svg.text: AIR-CLASSIFIER IMPACT MILL (ACM): MECHANICAL SPHERONIZATION OF FLAKE GRAPHITE
Stage 2 Flake Rounding: High-Shear Folding in a Pin-Rotor Chamber + Centrifugal Classifier Size Cut (ISO 10628 / ANL-22/74 Table 3)
BASIS: 1,000 kg FINISHED cSPG (24,300 kg ROM ORE)
CAD SECTION VIEW A-A | P&ID INSTRUMENTED

g.text: MECHANISM INSET: FROM PLATELET TO SPHEROID, AND WHERE THE MASS GOES
A. MORPHOLOGY EVOLUTION IN THE PIN-ROTOR CHAMBER (SIDE VIEW, NOT TO SCALE)
Rounding raises tap density (about 2.3x vs. flake), improves electrode packing and Li+ pathways, and hides reactive
edge planes. The price is mechanical: each pass sheds edge material, so more than half of the feed leaves as fines.
Remaining BET area is still 6.5-9.0 m2/g (too high) until pitch coating (Stage 4).
B. MASS BALANCE OF THE FLAKE FEED (2,534 kg = 100%)
Feed multiplier 2.22 t flake per t uSPG; scrap output 1.215 t per t uSPG (ANL-22/74 Table 3).
Fines are not waste: sold at ~$468/t, credited back against the cSPG cost (-$649/t).
C. STAGE 2 ENERGY & COST LEDGER (ANL-22/74 TABLE 3; DATASET graphite_process_energy_lca.csv)
Stage 2 = 27.4% of HF-route electricity: the single biggest cost lever before purification.
AUDIT METRICS: Elec: 1.899 kWh/kg uSPG | Core Yield: 45.05% | Fines: 54.73%
PRIMARY PROVENANCE: ANL GREET ANL-22/74 Table 3; Engels (2022); IEA (2024)
